name: deepseek-harness-electron
description: DeepSeek Harness desktop application with AWiki enabled by default
author: AgentConnect

scripts.start: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm run generate-icons && electron-forge start
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm run generate-icons && pnpm run stage-runtime && electron-forge package --platform=darwin --arch=arm64
scripts.make:mac: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm run generate-icons && pnpm run stage-runtime && electron-forge make --platform=darwin --arch=arm64
scripts.package:windows: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm run generate-icons && pnpm run stage-runtime && electron-forge package --platform=win32 --arch=x64
scripts.make:windows: pnpm --dir ../.. run build && pnpm run generate-icons && pnpm run stage-runtime && electron-forge make --platform=win32 --arch=x64
